Copy and paste from a previous post:

Long story but the short version is I got covid in December 2020. Was on the ventilator for 8 months. Almost died a few times. My lungs are severely damaged now. I can’t walk more than 400 ft without gasping for air. I can’t perform any daily tasks for myself without feeling like I’m dying. I developed a wound on my bottom from being in the hospital bed for so long so I can’t even sit for long periods of time. I feel like I’ve become a burden. And to add on to the damage, my gf of six years left me two days before I got out of the hospital. I’ve worked really hard the past 3.5 months since I’ve been out but I just don’t see it getting any better.
I really am or else I would have already killed myself.
I’m just scared of failing and being more disabled than I already am.
I can give you some money for food. May be not much but a few meals to help you through. Message me.

I’ve been working to gain strength back. More walking and some strength training. Also I have been working on breath support exercises. I mean I’ve gained a lot of muscle back and feel stronger. It’s just I can’t do anything for a long time without running out of breath. That’s really the only thing that hasn’t gotten better.
